the development of a query expansion method for the Ad Hock task and a query enrichment method for the Semantic Enchancement task.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the Wikipedia can be used for the enrichment of the query and the retrieval task.
the Wikipedia has a great potential as a semantic resource for cultural heritage information retrieval.

the Term Links can be integrated into a Language Model and it is easy to implement.
